title: Survey of Jail Inmates, 1972
description:
This study is a follow-up to the National Jail Census, 1970. 
 In addition to gathering more information concerning jails, the survey 
 also collected demographic data, incarceration history, and legal 
 status data from a sample of the inmates of local jails. The study 
 includes basic demographic data, income and employment data, reason for 
 incarceration, bail status, dates of admission and sentencing, length 
and type of sentence and previous incarceration history.
